kind: Direct3D 8/9 common device operations compatibility milestone

implementedOperations.TestCooperativeLevel: reports D3D_OK while the browser-backed device is operational
implementedOperations.GetAvailableTextureMem: returns a conservative approximate texture-memory budget
implementedOperations.EvictManagedResources: completes successfully for the current managed-resource model
implementedOperations.GetDisplayMode: reports the active swap-chain dimensions and format with pointer and index validation
implementedOperations.GetNumberOfSwapChains: reports the one implicit swap chain currently implemented
implementedOperations.MultiplyTransform: composes caller and current matrices in documented D3D order for D3D8 and D3D9
implementedOperations.ValidateDevice: reports one rendering pass for the currently supported state subset

browser.status: startup trial completed after first Present

scope: These common calls now return validated, conservative results instead of aborting D3D8/9 guests. The browser run proves the original Humus executable still creates Direct3D and presents a recognizable frame; it does not establish broad game compatibility.
